description: Look up what the workspace knows about a correspondent: name, kind (person, automated, sales or unknown), notes, custom metadata, labels, message count, the subject of the latest message and up to 10 recent threads. Pass contact_id or address (e.g. the sender of a message). Contacts are created automatically for the external addresses you exchange mail with (never for automated senders such as no-reply addresses).

contact_id.description: Contact id (contact_id field of a message).

name: get_contact
title: Get contact
